Inversely, what made the Roman army simultaneously weak against other enemies like the Germanic tribes and later foreign invaders? resposta: The Roman legions utilized rigorous training regimes to standardize combat effectiveness across diverse provinces. Engineers built extensive road networks that facilitated rapid troop movement throughout the empire linking Italy to Spain, North Africa, and the Levant. Could their logistical superiority alone explain victories against the Gauls and Carthaginians? Auxiliary troops provided necessary flexibility alongside the primary legions in frontier defenses. Strict discipline ensured that units remained organized even under extreme battlefield stress. How did they adapt their tactics against mobile enemies like the Britons who resisted conquest? Naval power allowed control over vital trade routes in the region including Alexandria and the Nile Valley. A decline in recruitment quality eroded the traditional skill set required for complex maneuvers. Did the economic strain on the state prevent the maintenance of elite professional forces?

```text
TITLE: THE ASCENT THAT NEVER WENT DOWN

FADE IN:
A silent, grey expanse of dust. The Lunar Module has stopped moving. The lights inside flicker once and die completely. 
The hum of the electrical systems cuts out.
Silence hangs heavy in the vacuum suit helmets.
COOL, HARD LIGHT OF THE STARS IS SHUT OUT BY THE METAL CASES.
ARMSTRONG STIRS SLIGHTLY ON HIS KNEES. HE LOOKS TOWARDS THE RADIO ANTENNA.
THE STATIC IS DEAD WEIGHT IN HIS EARS. NO SOUNDS COME.
A CRYSTAL GLASS OF PILL BOTTLE LIES BETWEEN THEM AND COLLINS.
IT'S SMALL. IT'S SIMPLE. IT'S THE ONLY OPTION LEFT.
COLLINS DOES NOT SPEAK FIRST. HE SAYS ONE WORD.
NOPE.
HE PICKS UP THE BOTTLE WITH BOTH HANDS. HE LOOKS AT ARMSTRONG LIKE A MOTHER LOOKING FOR A SON.
THEY KNOW THEY CANNOT ESCAPE TO THE MOON AGAIN. THEY ARE HERE NOW.
ARMSTRONG TAKES A BREATH THAT COSTS HIM EVERYTHING.
HE REACHES INTO HIS POCKET. HE FINDS THE WHITE SQUARE SHELL OF TRIPLET.
HE DOES NOT FEEL THE SWEETNESS. HE ONLY FEELS THE HEAVY PRESSURE.
THE SCREEN SHOWS THE RED LIGHT FLICKERS AGAIN. BUT NOW IT LOOKS LIKE A WARNING SIGNAL ON FIRE.
NIXON'S VOICE IS TRANSMITTED THROUGH THE MIC AS IF FROM FAR AWAY.
"NATURE DOES NOT FADE WITH TIME."
"NATURE DOES NOT END WITHOUT A HERO."
THE VOICE IS CLEAR. IT IS CLEAN. IT IS PERFECT.
"NINETY-TWO PERCENT OF AMERICA WILL REMEMBER THIS MOMENT."
NINETY-TWO PERCENT.
THEY LISTEN TO IT WHILE THEIR FATE GROWS DARKER.
THEY DO NOT UNDERSTAND THE NUMBERS.
THEY ONLY KNOW THE GRAVITY IS GETTING STRONGER.
A MAN CALLED COX IS SITTING RIGHT NEXT TO THEM NOW.
HE SAYS NOTHING ABOUT THE PLAN. HE SAYS NOTHING ABOUT THE PLAN.
HE JUST WATCHES THEM LOOK AT EACH OTHER'S EYES.
THEY SEE THE BLUE SKY BEHIND THEIR GLASSES.
THEY SEE THE BLACK HOLE OPENING IN FRONT OF THEIR THROATS.
THE YELLOWS IN THEIR VISION TURN TO WHITE THEN TO GREY.
THEY CATCH A SIGHT OF THE FLAG THAT WASN'T PLANTED YET.
THEY CATCH A SIGHT OF THE ROBIN THAT WASN'T LAUNCHED YET.
THEY CATCH A SIGHT OF THE WORD THAT WASN'T WRITTEN YET.
"HISTORY".
THAT ONE WORD IS ALL THEY NEED TO HOLD ON.
THEY TAKE THE PILL WITH THE FORCE OF A KNIFE.
THEY SWALLOW IT DOWN WITH THE WATER OF THEIR OWN TEARS.
THEY KNOW THE END IS NEAR.
THEY KNOW THE WORLD IS ALREADY BUILDING IT.
THEY KNOW THEY WILL BE THE FOUNDATION.
THEY FEEL THE HEAT START RISE INSIDE THEIR CHESTS.
THEY FEEL THE PULSE BECOME A METRONOME COUNTING DOWN.
THEY HEARD NIXON SAY ONE MORE TIME ABOUT THEIR NAME.
"LEGACY".
"LEGACY".
"LEGACY".
THEY DO NOT RESPOND ANYMORE.
THEY ARE JUST LISTENERS NOW.
THEY ARE JUST WHISPERING NOW.
THEY ARE JUST DREAMING NOW.
AS THE SOUND OF THE VOICE BECOMES LOUD AND FAR.
THE VOICE IS A LITTLE FURTHER NOW.
THE VOICE IS A LITTLE HIGHER.
THE VOICE IS A LITTLE CLOSER TO THEIR HEAD.
THEY ARE LOSING CONTROL.
THEY ARE LOSING EVERYTHING.
THEY ARE ONLY LEFT WITH THE MEMORY OF THE SOUND.
THE MEMORY OF THE SOUND THAT CAME FROM THE PRESIDENTIAL OFFICE.
THE SOUND OF A ROOM THAT IS EMPTY.
THE SOUND OF A PHONE LINE THAT HAS BEEN CUT.
THE SOUND OF A DEAD AIR WAVE.
THEY ARE GONE INTO THE SOIL.
THEY ARE GONE INTO THE STEEL.
THEY ARE GONE INTO THE SILENCE.
THE SILENCE IS THE FINAL MESSAGE.
THE FINAL MESSAGE IS NOT A QUESTION.
THE FINAL MESSAGE IS NOT A COMMAND.
THE FINAL MESSAGE IS NOT A PRAYER.
THE FINAL MESSAGE IS JUST A MEMORY OF ANOTHER MAN.
A MAN WHO DID WHAT THEY COULD NOT DO.
A MAN WHO GOT WHAT THEY WANTED MOST.
THEY CANNOT KNOW.
THEY CAN ONLY HEAR.
THEY CANNOT MOVE.
THEY CANNOT BREATHE.
THEY CANNOT DIE.
THEY ARE BORN BACK INTO THE VOID.
AND THE VOID IS NOT ENOUGH.
AND THE VOID IS STILL FARTHING AWAY.
AND THE VOID IS NEVER SURE.
THEY HAVE FINISHED THE JOURNEY.
THEY HAVE FINISHED THE TASK.
THEY HAVE FINISHED THE TASK.
THEY HAVE FINISHED THE TASK.
AND NOW THEY WAIT FOR THE END.
AND NOW THEY WAIT FOR THE END.
AND NOW THEY WAIT FOR THE END.
THEY ARE ALONE ON THE STAGE.
THEY ARE ALONE ON THE STAGE.
THEY ARE ALONE ON THE STAGE.
THE STAGE GOES BLACK.
```
